title: On Filling the bottles before dawn
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：fill　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fill 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 the planner ① filled the bottles before dawn on the same day, and every citizen in the district said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the planner ② fills the bottles before dawn before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ fill the bottles before dawn at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ filled the bottles before dawn before — a line in the report for March 1943 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Filling the bottles before dawn on the same day, the planner said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the plan at the far square, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ fill the whole room with their noise before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Fill the whole room with their noise at once and never mention it again.

By 1956 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the report, and a new citizen from the next district ⑧ fills the whole room with their noise on the same day every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the square, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ filled the bottles before dawn again when nobody else would.

⑩ To fill the bottles before dawn, my mother said in 1961, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the district remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the district forgets, somebody fills the bottles before dawn before dawn again and somebody must fill the bottles before dawn on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 装满（一般过去式 filled the bottles before dawn：1949 年规划员头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 装满（一般现在 fills the bottles before dawn：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 装满（不定式 to fill the bottles before dawn：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 装满（过去完成时 had filled the bottles before dawn：1943 年三月的规划报告上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 装满（动名词 filling the bottles before dawn 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 占满（fill the whole room with their noise：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去占满让他们的吵声充满整间屋）
G. v. 占满（fill the whole room with their noise：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 装满（后段两处：新来的市民照例 fills the whole room with their noise，而母亲又一次 filled the bottles before dawn）

answers.why: fill 意为“装满”，1949 年规划员当天就装满天亮前把瓶子都灌满，那是街区里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 filled。
fill 意为“装满”，自那以后规划员天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 fills。
fill 意为“装满”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯装满天亮前把瓶子都灌满”，此处为不定式 to fill the bottles before dawn。
fill 意为“装满”，规划报告里 三月 那行字说明早在 1956 年之前就有人装满过，故用过去完成时 had filled。
fill 意为“装满”，规划员说“装满天亮前把瓶子都灌满这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 filling the bottles before dawn 作主语。
fill 意为“占满”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去占满让他们的吵声充满整间屋”，should ever 之后用原形 fill the whole room with their noise。
fill 意为“占满”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻占满让他们的吵声充满整间屋（fill the whole room with their noise at once），以后再也不要提起。
fill 意为“装满”，新来的市民每个年份都照例占满让他们的吵声充满整间屋，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 fills。
fill 意为“装满”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就装满天亮前把瓶子都灌满，用一般过去式 filled 叙述。
fill 意为“装满”，结尾那句是母亲 1961 年的话：要装满天亮前把瓶子都灌满，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和街区记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1949 年，规划员当天就装满天亮前把瓶子都灌满；街区里每一个市民都说这是头一回。（filled the bottles before dawn）
多年以后，规划员仍天没亮就做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（fills the bottles before dawn）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯装满天亮前把瓶子都灌满这件事本身。（to fill the bottles before dawn）
早在 1943 年就有人装满天亮前把瓶子都灌满，三月那天规划报告上的一行字就是证据。（had filled the bottles before dawn）
规划员说过，当天就装满天亮前把瓶子都灌满这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（filling the bottles before dawn 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻占满让他们的吵声充满整间屋，以后再也不要提起。（fill the whole room with their noise，祈使句）
answers: In 1949 the planner filled the bottles before dawn on the same day, and every citizen in the district said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three years on, the planner still fills the bottles before dawn before dawn without being asked.
My mother said later that to fill the bottles before dawn at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had filled the bottles before dawn long before 1956, and the line in the report for March proves it.
Filling the bottles before dawn on the same day, the planner said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 fill 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1949 the planner filled the bottles before dawn on the same day, and nobody in the district forgot it.
Even now the planner fills the bottles before dawn before dawn whenever the district asks.
Filling the bottles before dawn on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever fill the whole room with their noise before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new citizen from the next district fills the whole room with their noise on the same day every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother filled the bottles before dawn again, and the district remembered that half.
